0022600157.text: The Lakers (4-2, 1st in the Pacific) host the Toronto Raptors (3-2, 4th in the East) after a loss in their last game, with Los Angeles at 2-1 at home and Toronto at 1-1 on the road. Los Angeles is without Adou Thiero (out, knee inflammation) and Ziaire Williams (day-to-day, game-time decision, foot), while Toronto is missing Kawhi Leonard (out, knee inflammation) and Nate Bittle (out, foot fracture). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Lakers swept the two games against Toronto in 2025-26, most recently winning 110-93 in Los Angeles on January 18, 2026.
